=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "IRQ-PARAM", "section": "1. Parameters", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."},
    {"id": "IRQ-RESET", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-REG-RW", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."},
    {"id": "IRQ-READ", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "section": "4.2 Detection", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "section": "4.2 Detection", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "section": "4.2 Detection", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-W1C", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "source": "interface_spec.md",
     "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_smoke",
     "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-MASK"],
     "rationale": "Reset, enable source 0 in level mode, drive it high, check PENDING bit 0 sets and irq rises with irq_id 0; then clear and check irq falls. Basic bring-up before the other tests."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_reset_values",
     "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"],
     "rationale": "Load ENABLE, MODE and PENDING with nonzero values and hold edge-mode sources high, then assert rst_n low for one edge. Check all three registers read zero. After reset, with MODE re-set to edge and the input still high, no edge is detected until the input goes low and high again (remembered level cleared to zero means a still-high input counts as a rising edge on the first edge after reset; the test checks exactly the spec's statement that the remembered level is zero)."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_enable_mode_rw",
     "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-READ"],
     "rationale": "Write walking-one, walking-zero and random patterns to ENABLE and MODE. Read each back and compare against wdata masked to bits N-1..0."},
    {"id": "T-UNUSED-BITS", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_unused_bits",
     "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"],
     "rationale": "Write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING and drive all src bits. Check bits N and up read zero in ENABLE, MODE and PENDING."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM-SWEEP", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_param_sweep",
     "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"],
     "rationale": "Run the full test list with N overridden to 2, 8 (default), 31 and 32, so both bounds and a non-power-of-two width are exercised against the scoreboard model."},
    {"id": "T-READ-SIDE-EFFECT", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_read_no_side_effect",
     "proves": ["IRQ-READ", "IRQ-CLAIM"],
     "rationale": "With sources pending, sweep addr 0..3 with we low over many cycles, including reads of PENDING and CLAIM. Check no register changes. Also change addr between edges and check rdata follows combinationally."},
    {"id": "T-LEVEL", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_level_detect",
     "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"],
     "rationale": "Per source in level mode: pulse the input high for one cycle, and hold it high across a W1C clear. Check PENDING sets at each edge where the input is high, including re-setting after a clear."},
    {"id": "T-EDGE", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_edge_detect",
     "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"],
     "rationale": "Per source in edge mode: hold the input high for many cycles, clear PENDING, and check it is not set again. Toggle low then high and check it sets once per low-to-high transition. Include back-to-back toggles."},
    {"id": "T-MODE-SWITCH", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_mode_switch",
     "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE"],
     "rationale": "Change MODE while inputs are high and low. Check the scoreboard model's prediction of detection (remembered level is tracked regardless of mode) matches PENDING."},
    {"id": "T-DETECT-DISABLED", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_detect_while_disabled",
     "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-MASK"],
     "rationale": "With ENABLE zero, trigger sources in both modes. Check PENDING sets and irq stays low. Then enable the source and check irq rises without a new trigger."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_pending_w1c",
     "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"],
     "rationale": "With several bits pending and inputs quiet, write patterns to PENDING. Check that exactly the bits written 1 clear, bits written 0 keep their value, and writing 1 to a clear bit does not set it."},
    {"id": "T-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_claim_ack",
     "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"],
     "rationale": "With several bits pending, write each source number to CLAIM and check only that bit clears. Write numbers N..31 and check nothing changes. Include upper wdata bits set to show only bits 4..0 are used."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_set_wins_over_clear",
     "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"],
     "rationale": "At the same edge as a W1C write and as a CLAIM acknowledge, detect the same source: a high level input, and a rising edge on an edge-mode input. Check PENDING stays set. Also check that a level source acknowledged while still high remains pending."},
    {"id": "T-MASK", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_irq_mask",
     "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"],
     "rationale": "Sweep combinations of PENDING and ENABLE across both modes. Check irq is high exactly when PENDING & ENABLE is nonzero, including toggling ENABLE on already-pending sources."},
    {"id": "T-PRIORITY", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_priority",
     "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"],
     "rationale": "Set multiple pending and enabled sources and check irq_id is the lowest-numbered one. Acknowledge the winner and check the next lowest wins. Check that a lower-numbered pending but disabled source does not win, and that irq_id is 0 when irq is low."},
    {"id": "T-CLAIM-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_claim_read_format",
     "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"],
     "rationale": "Read CLAIM with irq low and with each source winning. Check bit 31 equals irq, bits 4..0 equal irq_id, and bits 30..5 are zero."},
    {"id": "T-LATENCY", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_irq_latency",
     "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY"],
     "rationale": "Sample irq and irq_id just after each edge that sets PENDING, writes ENABLE, or clears a bit. Check they reflect the new register values in the same cycle with no extra register stage."},
    {"id": "T-RANDOM", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_random_stress",
     "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-READ", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM", "IRQ-LATENCY"],
     "rationale": "Constrained-random src, register writes, reads, acknowledges and occasional resets over long runs. A cycle-accurate reference model compares PENDING, rdata, irq and irq_id every cycle."},
    {"id": "A-MASK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equals_pending_and_enable",
     "proves": ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-LATENCY"],
     "rationale": "Combinational property: irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE) at all times. Intended for a formal run and for quiet simulation."},
    {"id": "A-PRIORITY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_id_lowest_set",
     "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"],
     "rationale": "irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, and equals 0 when irq is low."},
    {"id": "A-NO-SET-BY-WRITE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_pending_set_only_by_detect",
     "proves": ["IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK"],
     "rationale": "A PENDING bit rises only when its source is detected that edge, never because of a PENDING or CLAIM write."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_detect_overrides_clear",
     "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"],
     "rationale": "If source i is detected at an edge, PENDING[i] is 1 after that edge, whatever the write and ENABLE state."},
    {"id": "A-UNUSED-ZERO", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_unused_bits_zero",
     "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"],
     "rationale": "Bits N and up of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are always zero. Checked for each N in the parameter sweep."},
    {"id": "A-CLAIM-FORMAT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_claim_rdata_format",
     "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM", "IRQ-READ"],
     "rationale": "When addr == 3, rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}. For every addr, rdata equals the selected register combinationally."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
